svg.title: WebAssembly and Rust Runtime Architecture: Linear Memory and WASI
svg.desc: Architectural diagram illustrating WebAssembly linear memory layout, wasm-bindgen boundary crossing, WASI Preview 2 capability security, and binary optimization.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WebAssembly & Rust: Linear Memory & WASI Architecture

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sandboxed Linear Memory (64KB Pages), wasm-bindgen FFI, WASI Preview 2, and Component Model

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Sandboxed Linear Memory (WebAssembly.Memory)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Continuous 64KB Page Allocation

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Memory is a single continuous ArrayBuffer partitioned into 64KB pages

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Memory64 support expands accessible virtual address space up to 16GB

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Isolation: WASM cannot read or modify memory outside its linear buffer

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The Rust Zero-GC Performance Advantage

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Go / C# require bundling full garbage collection runtimes into .wasm

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Rust compiles with RAII ownership: Zero GC pauses, zero runtime bloat

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Delivers 5x to 15x faster execution on CPU-bound browser algorithms

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Result: Microsecond startup and deterministic execution latency

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. wasm-bindgen: Zero-Copy Boundary Crossing

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pointer & Length Marshaling Protocol

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • WASM functions accept and return raw numbers (i32 / i64 pointers)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • wasm-bindgen auto-generates glue code translating JS strings and structs

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Efficiency: Eliminates JSON serialization across the boundary

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Zero-Copy ArrayBuffer Views

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • JavaScript accesses WASM linear memory directly via Uint8Array

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • High-resolution video, audio, and image pixels processed in place

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Direct canvas ImageData rendering without intermediate copying

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Throughput: Enables 60 FPS real-time image and audio filters in browser

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. WASI Preview 2 & Edge Serverless

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Capability-Based Security Model

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • WebAssembly System Interface (WASI) runs outside the browser

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Pure capability-based security: Zero ambient authority or raw syscalls

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Network sockets and filesystem directories must be explicitly pre-opened

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Safety: Prevents arbitrary remote code execution and supply chain exploits

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Serverless Runtimes (Cloudflare / Fastly / Wasmtime)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Starts in <1 millisecond; 100x faster cold boots than Docker containers

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • WebAssembly Component Model allows composing Rust, Go & C++ modules

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Cloudflare Workers & Fastly Compute execute millions of isolated tasks

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Target: High-density microservices, sandboxed plugins & edge proxies

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Binary Optimization & Toolchain Pipeline

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 4-Step Release Toolchain

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • 1. rustup: Target wasm32-unknown-unknown or wasm32-wasip1

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • 2. wasm-pack: Compiles crate and generates JS/TS interface bindings

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • 3. wasm-opt -Oz: Shrinks generated bytecode by up to 40%

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Payload: Complex Rust engines compile to compact 50KB–250KB binaries

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Production Decision Boundary

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Use WASM: CPU-heavy video/audio, cryptography, local ML inference

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Do NOT Use: DOM manipulation, standard CRUD forms, or network fetching

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • The Golden Rule: WASM accelerates CPU math; JavaScript governs UI

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Strategy: Pair Rust WASM compute kernels with standard web frontends
